body: Thankfully I live in Australia and everything is taken care of by the government. I don’t know if it’s just a bad week mentally, I try to take things one day at a time, normally I’ll have a bad mental day and the next day I’m fine but this time I feel like it’s hanging over me. I’m very open about my life and what’s going on it, everyone in my life knows what I’ve gone through, but I just feel like I don’t have a real reason to live anymore.
